rule: Feasibility pack. No value is a model input: implementation_use is PROHIBITED (identity/class figures) or NOT_A_MODEL_PARAMETER (test domains). ALLOWED would require the source's own page inspected by the library (PAGE_VERIFIED), a known configuration, units, convention and a page/table/figure locator. Su-30, Su-33, Su-35 and other derivative, game and enthusiast data are never attached to the baseline configuration.

configurations.label: Baseline production Su-27 / Su-27S (single-seat): the study target
configurations.engine: AL-31F x2 (engine type per UEC family statement)
configurations.fcs: Production fly-by-wire (designation 'SDU-10' in secondary sources); laws, gains and limiter settings not public
configurations.dates: UNKNOWN (production dates not captured from a located primary source)
configurations.notes: Data attach here only when a source names the production Su-27 or Su-27S. A source that says only 'Su-27' goes to SU27-CFG-FAMILY-UNSPECIFIED until its content shows which aircraft. No located source separates Su-27 from Su-27S numerically; the pairing follows the requested baseline, and no recorded value depends on it.

configurations.engine: AL-31F afterburning turbofan with variable nozzle; 12,500 kgf class (UEC statement)

values.quantity: AL-31F thrust class (official statement; rating condition not stated)
values.location: news text: 'АЛ-31Ф тягой 12 500 кгс устанавливается на самолеты семейства Су-27' (search extract; page not opened)
values.reference_convention: Rating condition (afterburner, installed or uninstalled, altitude, Mach) NOT stated in the extract
values.notes: 12,500 kgf = 122.6 kN = about 27,560 lbf (arithmetic, 1 kgf = 9.80665 N). A class figure: never a thrust table and never used to scale a curve. Secondary sources also give a dry rating; none was located in an official source, so none is recorded.
